baseline.behavior: Context-pack outcomes calibrated telemetry and informed a shadow-only planner, but no persisted policy lifecycle or verified workflow-to-skill pipeline existed.

holdouts: policy lifecycle advances exactly one phase
shadow observations cannot satisfy a canary sample floor
mixed operator and persisted arm evidence is rejected
candidate identity binds its calibration evidence digest
candidate regeneration and stale transitions cannot regress lifecycle state
public promotion never activates runtime policy
skill draft requires three stable verified runs
training and holdout identities cannot overlap
holdouts require explicit identities and bounded evidence references
materially changed skill drafts receive new evaluation identities
identical skill draft replay cannot regress evaluated or exported state
skill export requires passing holdouts and named human approval
public skill export does not write into active skill roots
policy and foundry state reload from bounded ledgers

cost.candidate_generation_note: The administrative candidate path defensively clones at most the bounded in-memory telemetry window; it is not on retrieval or inference hot paths.

failures.resolution: regenerated and committed Go and Rust contract identities before further testing

failures.failure: mixed arm provenance, cross-phase samples, and mutable draft identity were not covered by the initial tests
